analyst.summary: Sai Life Sciences is a contract research, development and manufacturing partner to global pharma and biotech companies, benefiting from the industry-wide shift of manufacturing and development work away from Chinese suppliers. Growth has been strong and margins are improving, but the stock is priced richly (around 80x earnings) and working capital has deteriorated noticeably in recent quarters - receivable and inventory days have risen sharply - which is worth watching before treating the growth story as fully de-risked. We rate it a Hold.
